title.narrative: ENHANCING GROWTH AND PERFORMANCE OF THE COFFEE VALUE CHAIN IN ANGOLA

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Action is to contribute to the diversified, sustainable and inclusive growth of Angola. This Action is fully aligned with the National priority "Sustainable, Diversified and Inclusive Economic Development (National Development Plan 2018-2022 - Pillar 2)" and will serve to implement the Government's Support Programme for the Production, Diversification of Exports and Substitution of Imports (PRODESI0). .

The project will aim at providing leverages for enhance attractiveness for the value chain by promoting coffee varieties specific to the three target provinces. The project will contribute to increasing the volume of production, improving quality, setting up processes aimed at enhancing the origins of Angolan coffee, linking stakeholders in the sector and promoting exportsThe project will also strengthen dialogue and collaboration between public institutions in the coffee sector such as the National Coffee Institute (INCA), the National Institute for Support to SMEs (INAPEM), the National Agency for Investment and Export Promotion (AIPEX) and private actors in the value chain (producers, aggregators, processors and exporters).

The project will be implemented in three provinces where coffee production is the most dynamic and where specific varieties of coffee can be valued: Kwanza-Sul, Kwanza-Norte and Uíge.
